item.title: Minutes 1.2.0
item.description:
New

  • Audio only: turn off the Screen switch on the New session tab. The app records system audio and the microphone without a video (ADR-0032).
  • Menu of the menu bar icon: a right click or a Control-click opens a menu with Start or Stop recording, Stop transcription, Stop writing minutes, Settings and Quit (ADR-0033).

item.title: Minutes 1.1.0
item.description:
New

  • Continue recording: a stopped or interrupted session gets a new part. Start it from the session detail, the session list, a banner on the New session tab or the notification after an unexpected stop.
  • Merge with previous session: two sessions of one meeting become one session with one transcript and one summary. Finished part transcripts are reused.
  • The session detail and the list show the number of parts and an interrupted recording.
  • Updates: the app checks for a new version once a day and installs it with one click (Sparkle, ADR-0031). A blue dot next to the menu bar icon and a row in the popover show a new version. The app does not restart during a recording or a job. Settings → General turns the checks and the automatic install on or off. Version 1.0.0 has no updater: install this version manually one time.
  • Open source in About: links to the source code, the release notes of the running version, the user guide and a problem report with the app and macOS versions filled in.

Safety and reliability

  • Video and audio are written with movie fragments every 10 seconds. After a crash or a power loss, the recording stays readable (ADR-0030).
  • The app stops the recording correctly before it quits, before a restart or a shut down of the Mac, and before sleep.
  • At launch, the app repairs interrupted sessions and resets a transcription that a crash stopped.
